title: Local speech
description: Deterministic local CPU speech. Text mode speaks a sentence; words mode assigns each positive Notes event to the next word and maps MIDI pitch to voice pitch.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.doc: Speech renderer variant. humanico (the default) is the provisional local Klatt candidate; retro is versioned retro/formant-2.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.doc: text for ordinary speech or words for Notes-driven word-per-note speech.

parameters.name: duration_policy
parameters.doc: In words mode: natural keeps speech duration, gate crops at note length, fit accelerates up to 2x before cropping.

parameters.name: text
parameters.doc: Text to speak. It must not be empty: leave the line out instead. Give text or phonemes, never both.

parameters.name: phonemes
parameters.doc: Optional space-separated CMU-style phonemes with vowel stress, for example HH AH0 L OW1. Use instead of text, never together with it, and never empty.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.doc: Authored speaking rate, where 1 is the reference rate.

parameters.name: fit_max_rate
parameters.doc: Words mode fit ceiling: absolute effective rate, from authored rate up to 2.

parameters.name: pitch_hz
parameters.doc: Reference voice pitch in text mode.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.doc: Deterministic output gain applied after speech mixing.

parameters.name: reference_midi
parameters.doc: MIDI note mapped to reference_hz in words mode.

parameters.name: reference_hz
parameters.doc: Voice frequency at reference_midi in words mode.
